function.name: compose_melody
function.description: Compose a melody using the specified chord progression for a certain number of measures on specified instrument. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

measures.description: The number of measures of the melody.

instrument.description: The instrument for the composition. Default is 'Piano'.
